### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# Where enterprise AI runs and outcomes scale.

## The trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference
## and agents in production.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to
deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that
regulated and mission-critical environments demand.

[ Talk to an Expert ][117] [ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][118]

## Introducing our AI operating framework

Palantir has named Rackspace a preferred partner to deploy and operate Foundry and AIP for
regulated, sovereign and private cloud environments.

[ Read the Press Release ][119] [ Explore the Partnership ][120]
[Rackspace Palantir]
[Enterprise AI Cloud]

## Rackspace is the operator of the full enterprise AI stack.

### One partner. Full accountability.

We assemble, integrate and operate the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and
agents in production, and remain accountable for outcomes long after deployment is complete.

#### Curated partners across every layer of the stack.

We have assembled best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform
and infrastructure into a governed system, purpose-built for enterprise AI in regulated
environments.

#### Governance built in. Not bolted on.

Security, compliance, data sovereignty and uptime are foundational to every enterprise AI cloud we
operate, especially in regulated and high-stakes environments.

#### Forward deployed engineers who build, run and scale

Our engineers embed directly in your environment to build, operationalize and run enterprise AI,
turning use cases into production systems and scaling them over time.

[ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][121]

## Enterprise AI Cloud Partner Ecosystem

We have curated best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack. Our ecosystem is deliberate,
opinionated and selected for how partners integrate across the stack and how they perform within it.
Everything is stitched together and governed as one system, so you can focus on outcomes instead of
managing complexity.

[AMD][VMware by Broadcom][Palantir][UNIPHORE][Rubrik][Dell Technologies]
[Explore our Ecosystem][122]
[Seattle Children's Logo]

> “We partnered with Rackspace because of Fanatical Experience® and their ability to provide an
> infrastructure to a guaranteed uptime of 99.999%, which means that our clinicians would have
> secure access to our EMR around the clock at the point of care.”

Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer,
Seattle Children’s Hospital [ See the case study ][123]

[See more case studies][124]

## 25+ years of experience operating mission-critical infrastructure. We’re built to run what comes
## next.

From infrastructure to enterprise AI in production, our depth shows up in the certification our
engineers hold, the platforms we’re qualified to operated and the environments we’ve kept running
for the industries that trust us with their most critical systems.

2,200+ certified technical experts
10,000+ technical certifications
600+ AI platform certifications
39 data centers globally

## Industry-Recognized Leadership

Independently recognized by the leading analysts who cover enterprise infrastructure and AI.

[Forrester][Gartner][IDC][ISG]

## Ready to operationalize AI?

Let's explore your use cases and build the full-stack foundation for real outcomes.

[ Get Started ][125]

Airtame 3 combines faster performance and easier deployment in one device. It’s built for scale, so

With Cerebras’ inference speed, GSK is developing innovative AI applications, such as intelligent
research agents, that will fundamentally improve the productivity of our researchers and drug
discovery process.

Kim Branson

Our clinicians will be able to make more informed decisions based on genomic data, significantly
reducing the time it takes to find the right treatment and – more importantly – reducing the
physical toll on patients.

Matthew Callstrom, M.D., Ph.D

experience.

Sarah Sachs

Russell D’sa

Rick Stevens

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

THE DATABRICKS PLATFORM

## Build and run apps, agents
## and AI on your data

PlatformDatabaseAIBusiness intelligenceGovernanceData warehousingData engineering

### The Databricks Platform

Unify your data, analytics and AI. Use it to power agents, apps and natural language insights.

[Explore the platform][85]

### Modern applications need a lakebase

A lakebase delivers the unified transactional layer that ties together your data, AI and governance,
making it easy to build, deploy and manage production applications on a single platform.

[Explore Lakebase][86]

### Build AI agents that work in the real world

The best AI isn’t just smart — it works for your business. Build high-quality, production-ready AI
agents grounded in your data.

[Explore Agent Bricks][87]

### Intelligent analytics for all

The next generation of analytics is here. From natural language dashboard creation to deep
conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start. Now, everyone can
explore data and uncover insights.

[Explore AI/BI][88]

### Govern data and AI on one platform

Maintain compliance across data, models, dashboards and agents. Get deeper insight into your data
all in one unified, open governance layer.

[Explore Unity Catalog][89]

### The best warehouse is still a lakehouse

Eliminate legacy warehouse costs and lower TCO with an open, intelligent data warehouse.

[Explore Lakehouse][90]

### Build better data pipelines faster

Build reliable ETL pipelines for batch and streaming with Lakeflow. Ingest, transform and
orchestrate your data at scale with a unified solution.

[Explore Lakeflow][91]

### The Databricks Platform

Unify your data, analytics and AI. Use it to power agents, apps and natural language insights.

[Explore the platform][85]

### Modern applications need a lakebase

A lakebase delivers the unified transactional layer that ties together your data, AI and governance,
making it easy to build, deploy and manage production applications on a single platform.

[Explore Lakebase][86]

### Build AI agents that work in the real world

The best AI isn’t just smart — it works for your business. Build high-quality, production-ready AI
agents grounded in your data.

[Explore Agent Bricks][87]

### Intelligent analytics for all

The next generation of analytics is here. From natural language dashboard creation to deep
conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start. Now, everyone can
explore data and uncover insights.

[Explore AI/BI][88]

### Govern data and AI on one platform

Maintain compliance across data, models, dashboards and agents. Get deeper insight into your data
all in one unified, open governance layer.

[Explore Unity Catalog][89]

### The best warehouse is still a lakehouse

Eliminate legacy warehouse costs and lower TCO with an open, intelligent data warehouse.

[Explore Lakehouse][90]

### Build better data pipelines faster

Build reliable ETL pipelines for batch and streaming with Lakeflow. Ingest, transform and
orchestrate your data at scale with a unified solution.

[Explore Lakeflow][91]

Editorial

## The State of Quantum Computing in 2026

Quantum computing has moved beyond laboratory curiosities into a rapidly maturing industry. With
over 1162 companies operating across 54 countries, the quantum ecosystem now spans hardware
manufacturers, software developers, cloud service providers, security firms, and specialist
consultancies.

Quantum Navigator tracks this entire landscape, offering curated profiles, verified data, and market
intelligence maintained by the editorial team at [Quantum Zeitgeist][228].

The race to fault-tolerant quantum computing intensified in 2025, with several companies achieving
verified logical qubits through quantum error correction. QuEra Computing achieved 96 logical qubits
using a high-rate [[16,6,4]] code in January 2026, Quantinuum demonstrated 48 logical qubits with
its Helios trapped-ion system, and Google's Willow chip proved that surface-code error correction
can suppress errors exponentially.

2026 also marks a turning point for investment. The UK announced a £2B Quantum Leap programme in
March 2026, its largest single quantum investment, targeting 100,000 jobs and a world-first £1B
government quantum procurement initiative. The US Department of Energy committed $625M to renew its
National QIS Research Centers, while IonQ reported $130M in 2025 GAAP revenue, the first quantum
company to break the $100M barrier.

Whether you are an investor evaluating quantum startups, a researcher comparing hardware platforms,
or an enterprise exploring quantum-ready solutions, Quantum Navigator provides the data you need.
Explore our [company directory][229], track funding rounds on our [investment tracker][230], browse
[VCs & investors][231] and [incubators][232], compare qubit counts on the [leaderboard][233], or
visualize the global ecosystem on our [interactive map][234].

Editorial

## The State of Quantum Computing in 2026

Quantum computing has moved beyond laboratory curiosities into a rapidly maturing industry. With
over 1162 companies operating across 54 countries, the quantum ecosystem now spans hardware
manufacturers, software developers, cloud service providers, security firms, and specialist
consultancies.

Quantum Navigator tracks this entire landscape, offering curated profiles, verified data, and market
intelligence maintained by the editorial team at [Quantum Zeitgeist][228].

The race to fault-tolerant quantum computing intensified in 2025, with several companies achieving
verified logical qubits through quantum error correction. QuEra Computing achieved 96 logical qubits
using a high-rate [[16,6,4]] code in January 2026, Quantinuum demonstrated 48 logical qubits with
its Helios trapped-ion system, and Google's Willow chip proved that surface-code error correction
can suppress errors exponentially.

2026 also marks a turning point for investment. The UK announced a £2B Quantum Leap programme in
March 2026, its largest single quantum investment, targeting 100,000 jobs and a world-first £1B
government quantum procurement initiative. The US Department of Energy committed $625M to renew its
National QIS Research Centers, while IonQ reported $130M in 2025 GAAP revenue, the first quantum
company to break the $100M barrier.

Whether you are an investor evaluating quantum startups, a researcher comparing hardware platforms,
or an enterprise exploring quantum-ready solutions, Quantum Navigator provides the data you need.

[VCs & investors][231] and [incubators][232], compare qubit counts on the [leaderboard][233], or
visualize the global ecosystem on our [interactive map][234].

## The European Champions Alliance

The European Champions Alliance (ECA) promotes European technology and European values. We believe
that Europe’s strategic economic autonomy can be strengthened through a conscious business-related
interdependence between European companies and all participants of the European economic ecosystem.

Europe must build a strong regional economic network to foster innovation and technologies.
Embedding this network in the global world economy is indispensable, but should not prevent us from
putting the defense of European interests and values at the center.

To achieve this goal, the ECA builds bridges between national ecosystems, SMEs, companies and other
supporters of the tech ecosystem in Europe. We harness the power of smart collaboration and
accelerate the growth of Europe’s digital champions.

[ Our Impact ][102]

### Our Members

Our strength lies in our diversity. From DeepTech pioneers to industrial giants, our members are the
architects of Europe’s digital sovereignty.

[ Meet the Members ][103]

## Creating a Thriving Pan-European Community

## Empowering European Economic Sovereignty

European scale-ups are not fully leveraging the potential of the Single Market. The European
Champions Alliance (ECA) mobilizes its ecosystem to address key challenges, including:
* Market fragmentation
* Technical and operational barriers
* Cultural differences and trust gaps
* Limited funding

ECA is committed to driving change by shaping decision-makers’ perspectives, ensuring that
fast-growing scale-ups remain headquartered in Europe.

We unite industry experts and business leaders to foster cross-border collaboration and innovation.
Through a pan-European network ECA delivers hands-on strategic and operational support in
international business development, sales, marketing, recruitment, governance, and operational
scaling.

## Our Vision

We want start-ups founded in Europe to take the technological lead in key technologies of the
future, remain in European hands, and accompany, support and protect our citizens and industries in
the digital age!

[ Become a member of our Community ][104]

interdependence between European companies and all participants of the European economic ecosystem.

Europe must build a strong regional economic network to foster innovation and technologies.

supporters of the tech ecosystem in Europe. We harness the power of smart collaboration and

transformation in key strategic sectors.

[ Our Impact ][102]

### Our Members

Our strength lies in our diversity. From DeepTech pioneers to industrial giants, our members are the
architects of Europe’s digital sovereignty.

[ Meet the Members ][103]

## Creating a Thriving Pan-European Community

## Empowering European Economic Sovereignty

European scale-ups are not fully leveraging the potential of the Single Market. The European
Champions Alliance (ECA) mobilizes its ecosystem to address key challenges, including:
* Market fragmentation
* Technical and operational barriers
* Cultural differences and trust gaps
* Limited funding

ECA is committed to driving change by shaping decision-makers’ perspectives, ensuring that
fast-growing scale-ups remain headquartered in Europe.

We unite industry experts and business leaders to foster cross-border collaboration and innovation.
Through a pan-European network ECA delivers hands-on strategic and operational support in
international business development, sales, marketing, recruitment, governance, and operational
scaling.

## Our Vision

We want start-ups founded in Europe to take the technological lead in key technologies of the
future, remain in European hands, and accompany, support and protect our citizens and industries in
the digital age!

[F logo]
Fathom.ai
Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

At Hubzone Depot, we believe purchasing doesn’t have to be complicated.  As a woman-owned,

one-time Spotbuy needs to ongoing small parcel auditing.  Our team brings decades of procurement
expertise, proven supplier relationships, and the flexibility to source from anywhere value can be

Partnership

We serve as an extension of your logistics and procurement team, combining technology, experience,
and strategy to deliver smarter auditing, measurable savings, and continued Tier 1
supplier-diversity performance.

Vision

performance-driven, empowering organizations to reduce costs and hold carriers accountable.

Mission

To help organizations recover what they’re owed, improve carrier performance, and optimize future
shipping agreements, while upholding integrity, responsiveness, and diversity in every engagement.

Procurement is only as strong as the people behind it

At Hubzone Depot, our strength comes from the expertise of the people who power our mission.  Our
team combines decades of experience in supply chain, logistics, and procurement to deliver fast,
reliable results through our Spotbuy and Small Parcel Auditing programs.  We’re more than a
supplier, we’re your Tier 1 diversity partner, dedicated to helping organizations buy smarter and
save more.

## solutions for every need

We help organizations simplify purchasing and optimize logistics through two proven
programs, Spotbuy and Small Parcel Auditing, supported by data-driven insights, supplier diversity,
and best-in-class service.

### Spotbuy procurement

Our RFQ/RFP sourcing platform for tail spend, bulk buys, and hard-to-procure products. We source
from national suppliers and the open market to deliver fast, compliant, and cost-effective quotes.

### Small parcel auditing

We review carrier invoices, verify discounts, identify service failures, and recover lost credits,
helping clients maximize their shipping efficiency and savings.

### Dedicated support

Our procurement team is available around the clock to manage sourcing requests, vendor
communication, and fulfillment follow-ups, giving the best possible support.

requirements for public and private organizations across the United States.

Every Spotbuy and audit engagement includes cost analysis, trend tracking, and benchmarking to help
your organization continuously improve its procurement performance.

Gain clear visibility into every RFQ, quote, and audit result. Our custom reporting highlights
performance, compliance, and supplier-diversity metrics.

## Industry use case highlights

[

### Quantum-accelerated drug development

In collaboration with AstraZeneca, AWS, and NVIDIA, IonQ executed the largest quantum-accelerated
electronic structure simulation performed to date. This groundbreaking approach accelerated the
complex chemistry simulation by at least 656 times.

Read more
][108][
[Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning]

### Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning

IonQ's quantum fine-tuning is a hybrid approach that adds a quantum layer to classical AI models.
This method makes LLMs smarter and more efficient by capturing higher-dimensional patterns that
classical systems miss.

Read more
][109][

### Advancing automotive materials with quantum AI

IonQ partnered with a leading global automotive manufacturer, applying quantum-classical AI to solve
critical materials science challenges. Our model successfully generated higher-fidelity synthetic
data for steel microstructures.

Read more
][110][
[Unlocking foundry-scale quantum production]

### Unlocking foundry-scale
### quantum production

IonQ is pioneering the use of quantum-grade diamond thin films, a breakthrough that allows diamond
quantum devices to be manufactured at an industrial scale. This approach leverages semiconductor
techniques, dramatically simplifying manufacturing.

Read more
][111][
[Enterprise ready quantum computer]

### Machine learning image recognition

For self driving cars to become a reality, vehicles must interface with road signs in the physical
world. In our work with Hyundai, we explored loading images of road signs into our quantum computers
for analysis. With only 8 qubits, we successfully trained a quantum machine learning image
recognition algorithm to recognize common road signs with fewer input parameters than comparable
classical approaches.

Read more

# BUILT RUGGED. BUILT READY
# AI Computers for the Edge and High-Availability Servers in the Cloud

Press Release

## Premio Appointed to Intel United States Channel Board of Advisors

Big news! As Premio celebrates 37 years of engineering and deploying global computing solutions, we
are excited to announce our appointment to the Intel United States Channel Board of Advisors

[Learn more][144]

Events

## Meet Premio at Automation Expo 2026

Automation Expo 2026 is Asia’s biggest automation showcase and the global stage for automation
excellence, bringing together the world’s leading innovators in industrial automation, robotics,
IIoT, and smart manufacturing.

Visit Premio at Automation India Expo 2026 (Hall 6, Booth C12, BEC Mumbai) and learn how semi-rugged
and super-rugged platforms support different industrial automation environments.

[Learn more][145]

New Products

## x86 Intel Super-Rugged Fanless Mini PCs

Discover RCO-1000-ASL Series, our next-generation x86 super-rugged fanless mini pcs powered by
Intel® X7000 series processors.
* Up to 91% higher CPU performance with up to 8 processing core
* Dedicated RCO-1000-ASL-20-OOB model with remote management support
* Compact, fanless, and super-rugged design

[Learn more][146]

New Products

## NVIDIA Jetson Super-Rugged Fanless Mini PCs

Discover JCO-1000-ORN Series, our next-generation NVIDIA Jetson super-rugged fanless mini pcs
powered by Jetson Orin modules.
* NVIDIA® Jetson Orin™ Nano & NX Super series delivers up to 157 TOPS for AI, vision, robotics, and
  automation.
* Flexible Connectivity & Expansion – High-speed networking, wireless connectivity, various camera
  support, and industrial I/O
* Compact, fanless, and super-rugged design

[Learn more][147]

New Products

## Washdown Ready Stainless Steel Panel PCs

Discover SIO-300-ASL Series, our next-generation x86 washdown ready stainless steel panel PCs
powered by Intel® N and X7000 series processors.
* Fanless SUS316 stainless steel enclosure
* IP66 / IP69K washdown protection
* Dual 2.5GbE LAN with M12
* Optical bonding with 7H touch glass

[Learn more][148]

Insights

## Beyond the Chat Box:
## Why Physical AI Requires a Ruggedized Foundation

As artificial intelligence steps out of the screen and into the physical world, intelligence alone
isn't enough. Discover why the future of autonomous systems, smart manufacturing, and edge computing
depends on durable, ruggedized hardware built to survive harsh environments.

[Learn more][149]

Solutions

## Remote Management

Premio’s remote management solutions keep edge devices connected, accessible, and recoverable:
• EDGEBoost OOB: Hardware-level remote recovery and control.
• Allxon: Centralized monitoring and fleet management.

[Learn more][150]

Solutions

## Industrial GPU Computers

Deploy edge AI technologies on-premises with purpose-built industrial GPU computers. Premio’s x86
and ARM systems, powered by NVIDIA GPUs and Jetson module accelerators, deliver real-time AI
inferencing to mission-critical machine vision applications.

[Learn more][151]

Markets

## The AI Factory at the Edge

The AI Factory merges intelligence, automation, and data into a self-learning ecosystem that turns
sensor inputs into real-time action. Powered by edge and on-prem AI inference, it connects the
physical and digital worlds to drive smarter, faster, and more resilient manufacturing.

[Learn more][152]

Case Studies

## Real-World Solutions

Dive into our success stories showcasing real-world solutions and tangible results. From
cutting-edge technology implementations to intelligent industry 4.0 transformations, these case
studies provide invaluable insights into how our solutions drive success across diverse industries
for computing.

[Learn more][153]

Decision Toolkits

## Select the Perfect Edge AI PC

Discover the perfect AI edge computing solution with Premio's decision toolkits. Get guidance on
choosing a robust edge AI computer for high-performance computing in tough environments and
specialized markets like industrial smart manufacturing, robotics, and edge AI and more

[Download now][154]

Your path to industrial-grade computing and hardware design simplified.

We specialize in cutting-edge computing solutions, offering unparalleled reliability, performance,

we design and deliver the computing technology backbone for your success.

Your turnkey localized manufacturing and deployment partner in North America.

enable fast-time-market for enterprise results in the United States of Am

# BUILT RUGGED. BUILT READY
# AI Computers for the Edge and High-Availability Servers in the Cloud

Press Release

## Premio Appointed to Intel United States Channel Board of Advisors

Big news! As Premio celebrates 37 years of engineering and deploying global computing solutions, we
are excited to announce our appointment to the Intel United States Channel Board of Advisors

[Learn more][144]

Events

## Meet Premio at Automation Expo 2026

Automation Expo 2026 is Asia’s biggest automation showcase and the global stage for automation
excellence, bringing together the world’s leading innovators in industrial automation, robotics,
IIoT, and smart manufacturing.

Visit Premio at Automation India Expo 2026 (Hall 6, Booth C12, BEC Mumbai) and learn how semi-rugged
and super-rugged platforms support different industrial automation environments.

[Learn more][145]

New Products

## x86 Intel Super-Rugged Fanless Mini PCs

Discover RCO-1000-ASL Series, our next-generation x86 super-rugged fanless mini pcs powered by
Intel® X7000 series processors.
* Up to 91% higher CPU performance with up to 8 processing core
* Dedicated RCO-1000-ASL-20-OOB model with remote management support
* Compact, fanless, and super-rugged design

[Learn more][146]

New Products

## NVIDIA Jetson Super-Rugged Fanless Mini PCs

Discover JCO-1000-ORN Series, our next-generation NVIDIA Jetson super-rugged fanless mini pcs
powered by Jetson Orin modules.
* NVIDIA® Jetson Orin™ Nano & NX Super series delivers up to 157 TOPS for AI, vision, robotics, and
  automation.
* Flexible Connectivity & Expansion – High-speed networking, wireless connectivity, various camera
  support, and industrial I/O
* Compact, fanless, and super-rugged design

[Learn more][147]

New Products

## Washdown Ready Stainless Steel Panel PCs

Discover SIO-300-ASL Series, our next-generation x86 washdown ready stainless steel panel PCs
powered by Intel® N and X7000 series processors.
* Fanless SUS316 stainless steel enclosure
* IP66 / IP69K washdown protection
* Dual 2.5GbE LAN with M12
* Optical bonding with 7H touch glass

[Learn more][148]

Insights

## Beyond the Chat Box:
## Why Physical AI Requires a Ruggedized Foundation

As artificial intelligence steps out of the screen and into the physical world, intelligence alone
isn't enough. Discover why the future of autonomous systems, smart manufacturing, and edge computing
depends on durable, ruggedized hardware built to survive harsh environments.

[Learn more][149]

Solutions

## Remote Management

Premio’s remote management solutions keep edge devices connected, accessible, and recoverable:
• EDGEBoost OOB: Hardware-level remote recovery and control.
• Allxon: Centralized monitoring and fleet management.

[Learn more][150]

Solutions

## Industrial GPU Computers

Deploy edge AI technologies on-premises with purpose-built industrial GPU computers. Premio’s x86
and ARM systems, powered by NVIDIA GPUs and Jetson module accelerators, deliver real-time AI
inferencing to mission-critical machine vision applications.

[Learn more][151]

Markets

## The AI Factory at the Edge

The AI Factory merges intelligence, automation, and data into a self-learning ecosystem that turns
sensor inputs into real-time action. Powered by edge and on-prem AI inference, it connects the
physical and digital worlds to drive smarter, faster, and more resilient manufacturing.

[Learn more][152]

Case Studies

## Real-World Solutions

Dive into our success stories showcasing real-world solutions and tangible results. From
cutting-edge technology implementations to intelligent industry 4.0 transformations, these case
studies provide invaluable insights into how our solutions drive success across diverse industries
for computing.

[Learn more][153]

Decision Toolkits

## Select the Perfect Edge AI PC

Discover the perfect AI edge computing solution with Premio's decision toolkits. Get guidance on
choosing a robust edge AI computer for high-performance computing in tough environments and
specialized markets like industrial smart manufacturing, robotics, and edge AI and more

[Download now][154]

## Your Inside Outsource for Computing Success

### Who We Are

Your path to industrial-grade computing and hardware design simplified.

We specialize in cutting-edge computing solutions, offering unparalleled reliability, performance,
and customization. From high-performance servers, rugged industrial PCs, and Rugged Touch displays,
we design and deliver the computing technology backbone for your success.

### What We Do

Your turnkey localized manufacturing and deployment partner in North America.

Our engineering expertise, high-mix manufacturing, and commercial off-the-shelf computing products
enable fast-time-market for enterprise results in the United States of Am

Powering the Future of Creativity

[Try The Render Network][1]

##### Transform your Creative Workflow with the Speed and Scale of the Render Network

The Render Network is the world's first decentralized GPU rendering platform designed to supercharge
your creative workflow. We harness idle global GPU power to provide you with unlimited rendering
power at a fraction of the cost – with workflow acceleration tools like the [**C4D Wizard**][2].

The decentralized project is supported by the [Render Network Foundation][3], a not-for-profit
dedicated to advancing the core Render Network protocol and fostering the growth of its vibrant
community.

[Getting Started][4]

## Cloud rendering made easy, secure, and affordable

Key Benefits

#### Fast

Create for next generation resolutions at incredible speeds with parallelized rendering

#### Elastic

Decentralized supply provides near unlimited scale to meet any project's need

#### Affordable

Simple, on-demand pricing with no minimum spends or upfront commitments

#### The Future of 3D Rendering and Generative AI Imaging

The Render Network combines support for the leading GPU render engines **OctaneRender, Redshift, and
Blender Cycles** with the latest generative AI imaging tools from **Runway, Black Forest Labs, Luma
Labs, and Stability AI **– providing an integrated platform for next generation digital creation
workflows.

Harness the latest generative AI, 3D rendering, and spatial imaging tools in a unified artist
friendly interface – with push-button access to near unlimited on-demand high-performance GPU
compute power.

What GPU infrastructure does Runpod offer for AI workloads?

Runpod offers three primary infrastructure products: [Serverless][49] (autoscaling GPU endpoints
that scale to zero when idle), [Pods][50] (GPU instances for persistent compute and development –
available as Reserved (guaranteed) or Spot (interruptible, lower price), and [Clusters][51]

catalog (H100 80GB HBM3, H100 NVL, A100, L40S, and more) accessible on-demand with no contracts or
minimum commitments. [See pricing][52]

What is AI Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), and how does it compare to building your own?

# Limitless AI hardware at the edge.

[Grey Page Divider]

SNUC is redefining what’s possible at the edge with compact, rugged, and intelligent systems built
for the places traditional infrastructure can’t always go. From AI workloads to mission-critical
operations, our solutions reduce latency, improve uptime, and bring compute power closer to where
decisions happen in real time.

[Explore Edge Systems][34][Talk to an Expert][35][Play Video

Watch the full video

][36]

INDUSTRIES

## Built for real-world edge environments.

[Grey Page Divider]

SNUC systems support demanding environments where compute needs to run closer to the work, from
factory floors and federal operations to healthcare, retail, education, and AV deployments.

#### Manufacturing

Run automation, machine vision, monitoring, and industrial workloads closer to the equipment and
operators that depend on them.

Explore Manufacturing

[Explore industrial edge computing solutions][37]

#### Federal

Support secure, mission-ready operations with compact systems built for distributed and
space-constrained environments.

Explore Federal

[Explore edge computing solutions for federal operations][38]

#### Retail & QSR

Power digital signage, kiosks, analytics, and connected store experiences with dependable
small-form-factor compute.

Explore Retail & QSR

[Explore edge computing solutions for retail and quick-service restaurants][39]

#### Healthcare

Enable reliable compute for clinical workstations, imaging environments, patient-facing systems, and
connected care.

Explore Healthcare

[Explore healthcare edge computing solutions][40]

#### Education

Support classrooms, labs, digital learning spaces, and campus technology with compact systems that
are easy to deploy.

Explore Education

[Explore edge computing solutions for education and campus technology][41]

#### Audio Visual

Drive displays, collaboration spaces, media installations, and AV control systems with dependable
edge-ready compute.

Explore Audio Visual

[Explore audio visual edge computing solutions][42]

## No room required.

insights are made: reducing cloud costs, cutting latency, and keeping your mission-critical systems

Power + data in a single streamlined connection, simplifying deployments and reduce infrastructure

Connectivity  anywhere. No wiring, no problem, connect and scale instantly without relying on fixed

Secure, remote management at the BIOS level, reduceing service calls and downtime with secure

## Built for the EDGE.

businesses harness the power of edge computing.

We’re still delivering the custom mini PC solutions our customers trust, from workstations to

devices designed to work in concert with your existing infrastructure. That’s where we’re headed,

## Solutions that power progress

From AI and cloud to cybersecurity, digital workplace and enterprise computing solutions, we deliver
the technology foundation and industry expertise your organization needs to excel.

### AI that drives human innovation

Turn AI investments into business results. Unisys combines strategic AI advisory, solution
development, and scalable infrastructure with the change management expertise you need to succeed.
We help you put AI to work where it matters most, positioning you to compete and grow with
confidence.

[
Learn more
][139]

### Cloud management that simplifies your cloud journey

Get more from your cloud investments. Unisys cloud solutions simplify migration, modernization and
cloud management across cloud hosts like AWS, Azure, Google, and your data center. Intelligent
automation simplifies complexity while keeping costs predictable and performance strong.

[
Learn more
][140]

### Modern applications that deliver business value, wherever your organization runs

Thrive in a digital-first world by modernizing existing applications, embedding AI-driven
intelligence and automation, and securely developing new ones that prioritize user experience.
Unisys helps you modernize legacy apps, migrate to the cloud, and build cloud-native solutions that
are scalable, intuitive, and cost-effective. Run your business with applications tailored to you.

Learn more
